items.t: The Sharing Center marks 40 years of helping Seminole County residents
items.x: The Sharing Center celebrates four decades of providing food, housing assistance, and other essential services to thousands in Seminole County.

items.t: UCF fined $100K over ‘discriminatory’ anti-Mormon chants at football game
items.x: The University of Central Florida was issued a $100K by the Big 12 over “discriminatory” chants performed by students at a football game.

items.t: Orlando Greek Fest has all the sights, sounds and Mediterranean eats you can handle
items.x: Our mouths water just thinking about the dolmades, but at Orlando Greek Fest you can also stuff your face with gyros, saganaki, galaktoboureko, souvlaki, spanakopita, baklava and jarringly strong coffee to spur you on toward your next…

items.t: ‘An attack on our community’: Orlando gay bars wiped from Instagram after Pride posts
items.x: Queer-owned businesses across the country have had their social media accounts wiped this year without explanation.

items.t: The magic of drag brings the ‘Golden Girls’ back to Orlando for some wild new capers
items.x: More than 40 years after The Golden Girls first invited viewers into their Miami living room (and respective boudoirs!), Dorothy, Blanche, Rose and Sophia are back, but this time they’re in drag.

items.t: Drummer and composer Marcos Morales pushes Orlando jazz forward with ‘Elfos’
items.x: For his latest edition of Elfos, Marcos Morales selected credentialed Orlando saxophonist Ryan Devlin, who proves himself an inspired and disciplined foil.

items.t: Florida ranks third most gerrymandered U.S. state, per New York Times analysis
items.x: Florida ranked as the third most aggressively gerrymandered state in the U.S. Florida's just behind Texas at No. 1 and California at No. 2.

items.t: AOC stumps for Angie Nixon in Central Florida before election day
items.x: U.S. House Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY), arguably one of the most high-profile politicians in the country, joined Florida’s U.S. Senate candidate Angie Nixon for a “Boricuas for Angie” rally in Kissimmee Tuesday night to highlight…

items.t: Horror con Spooky Empire happens in Orlando over Halloween weekend
items.x: Horror con Spooky Empire, much like a good slasher-flick villain, is back for another installment in Orlando on Halloween weekend.

items.t: Court suggests Florida teacher shouldn’t be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk’s death
items.x: A Florida judge last week recommended dismissing a misconduct case against a Clay County teacher for a post celebrating Kirk's death.

items.t: Uthmeier says property risk-assessment company ‘is marketing fear to advance a climate activism agenda’
items.x: Florida has sued a company that issues climate change assessments of property risks including flooding that the state alleges are deceptive

items.t: Man, 69, shot and killed both roommates after fight over ice cream, Ocala police say
items.x: It happened Wednesday in what police called a "dysfunctional living arrangement"

items.t: Wanted man arrested after three-hour manhunt in Canaveral National Seashore
items.x: A wanted man was apprehended in Florida wetlands after threatening deputies and fleeing a New Smyrna Beach driveway.

items.t: Davenport jiu-jitsu community brings together beginners, families and a 61-year-old black belt
items.x: Gracie Barra Davenport explores why Brazilian jiu-jitsu attracts hobbyists seeking connection and physical puzzles.

items.t: Man arrested after shooting, killing his 2 roommates in Ocala, police say
items.x: A man was taken into custody after two other men were fatally shot Wednesday in Ocala, according to police.

items.t: Florida man shoots and kills roommates over arguments about ice-cream, police say
items.x: A Florida man is accused of shooting and killing both of his roommates after an alleged argument over ice cream, according to the Ocala Police Department.

items.t: City of Titusville appoints new police chief after John Lau fired earlier this year
items.x: Tyler "TJ" Wright will step into the role beginning Nov. 2.

items.t: Judge blocks Trump administration's Medicaid rule forcing sick recipients to prove frailty
items.x: A federal judge has ruled that chronically ill people on Medicaid won’t be bound by new work requirement rules that the latest Trump administration guidance requires in order to qualify for “medically frail” exemptions.

items.t: Before and after photos show beach erosion impacts in Brevard County
items.x: The combination of strong winds and the high tides, also known as "king tides," has caused high surf and significant erosion along Brevard beaches.

items.t: Virginia GOP says shooting outside its offices in Richmond appears unrelated to its operations
items.x: A woman has been shot just outside the Republican Party of Virginia's offices in Richmond.
